title: Annihilation and completion-isomorphism transport through the thickening dictionary
statement: Let A be a Noetherian ring, I an ideal, and f:X → Spec A a finite type morphism. Put X_n = X × Spec(A/I^(n+1)), with canonical transition maps i_n:X_n → X_(n+1) specified by their two projections, and j_n:X_n → X. Let c_n be the specified canonical tensor-pullback composition comparisons and let (F_n,φ_n) be a coherent thickening system [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-systems-dictionary]. Let j:Z → X be a closed immersion whose kernel ideal annihilates every j_(n,*)F_n sectionwise. Then X is Noetherian and there is a coherent formal module M on (X,(ker(Spec(A/I) → Spec A)).comap f) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] supported on Z. For every coherent G on X and every isomorphism completion(G) ≅ M there are isomorphisms ψ_n:j_n^*G ≅ F_n satisfying i_n^*(ψ_(n+1)) ≫ φ_n = c_(n,G) ≫ ψ_n. Completeness of A, separatedness of f, and properness of Z are not assumed.

proof.text: Apply thickeningSystems_dictionary to F, φ, hF with the tensor-pullback adjunctions. It gives Noetherian X, the formal object, and evaluation isomorphisms with pushed terms.
Identify the kernel ideal of Spec(A/I) → Spec A with the ideal sheaf associated to I, and extend along f. This changes the dictionary ideal to the displayed one.

Transport sectionwise annihilation through the linear evaluation isomorphisms. Multiplication of the ideal with a formal term has zero image precisely because every local product is zero; hence SupportedOn holds.

Obtain the dictionary comparison d. Normalize the system comparisons by the inverse of the automorphism d.inv ≫ c.hom of j_n^*: transport it to modules on X_n by the invertible counit of fully faithful closed pushforward. Apply the dictionary to this modified system. Full faithfulness and the completion comparison recover compatible restriction isomorphisms. Naturality of the transported automorphism changes their equation back to the original φ and the specified c. This does not identify arbitrary adjunction choices by uniqueness alone.

theorem supportedThickening_dictionary
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (i : ∀ n : ℕ, pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))) ⟶
      pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1))))))
    (hi : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))))
    (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, i n ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n
      + 1 + 1))))) = pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n +
      1))))) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I :=
      I) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))))
    (c : ∀ n : ℕ, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 + 1)))))) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))))
    (hc : ∀ n : ℕ, c n = (Classical.choice (Scheme.Modules.nonempty_tensorPullbackComp (i n)
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1 +
      1)))))))).symm ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (hi n)))
    (F : ∀ n : ℕ, (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).Modules)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).obj (F (n + 1)) ≅ F n)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1)))))).toRingedSpace (F n))
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hkill : ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (a : Γ(X, V)),
        a ∈ j.ker.idealOfOpens V →
        ∀ t : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj (F n), V),
          a • t = 0) :
    ∃ hX : IsNoetherian X,
      ∃ M : @CoherentFormalModule X hX
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f),
        @SupportedOn X Z hX
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f) M j _ ∧
        ∀ G : CoherentModules X,
          Nonempty ((@completion X hX
            ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))).ker.comap f)).obj G ≅ M) →
          ∃ ψ : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))))).obj G.obj ≅ F n,
            ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (ψ (n + 1)).hom ≫
              (φ n).hom = (c n).hom.app G.obj ≫ (ψ n).hom
